Description: Generative Face Description: produces the Machine Face Descriptors - the whole facial animation to display - from the machine's Face Personal Status (Emotion -> expression Action Units via EM-FACS), the Text (words -> phonemes -> viseme mouth shapes) and the Machine Speech (duration + amplitude envelope that times and gates the mouth). The output is a Face Descriptors Object whose FaceDescriptorsData is a timeline: a sequence of frames, each a Time and the Action Unit weights for that instant (expression merged with the frame's viseme). The lip movement is IN the descriptors, format-independent and interoperable.
